tools.name: search
tools.description: Search documents by keywords. Optionally filter to a specific file using file_id. If no file_id is provided, searches all files.

query.description: Keywords or phrase to search for.

file_id.description: Optional. File ID from list_files to restrict search to one file.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a specific section by ID. Includes full text, hierarchy info, and optionally adjacent sections for context.

section_id.description: The section ID from search results.

include_context.description: Optional. Include previous and next sections for context (default false).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get content from a specific page number. Optionally filter to a specific file using file_id. If no file_id is provided, searches all files.

file_id.description: Optional. File ID from list_files to restrict to one file.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all available documents with their IDs, types, and metadata.
